K01.drivers: Massive barrel trunk with no waist, arms bowed out leaving gaps at the armpit, short thick bowed legs, enormous broad splayed feet; profile shows bent knees, legs angled forward and a heavy, flat-footed base
axial_cues: barrel trunk with no waist taper
trunk wider than the hips and merging into the pelvis
limb_cues: arms bowed away from the body
short thick legs with knobby knees

structure.axial_section_shape: deep barrel/block trunk, chest and pelvis one mass with no waist
structure.joint_integration: knobby bulging knees and elbows; shoulders sunk into the trunk mass; thick ankles flaring into huge feet
structure.segment_relations: long massive trunk, short legs, long heavy arms, huge hands and feet
structure.load_path: weight drops through a wide pelvis into flexed, bowed legs onto broad splayed feet

non_structural_factors.notes: bulk and bent-knee stance amplify a body that is built differently

K02.drivers: Slender, typical human proportions, upright straight legs, normal feet

structure.load_path: vertical through straight legs to the heels

K03.drivers: Very narrow, elongated build; long thin arms with hands reaching low; small trunk; profile shows a strong rounded upper back and chest with a deep S-curve; spindly legs with knee bulges
axial_cues: teardrop profile trunk with a bulging upper back
limb_cues: hands hang to mid-thigh or lower

structure.axial_section_shape: narrow front, deep rounded upper back and chest in profile, pinched waist
structure.joint_integration: knobby, narrow joints with little soft-tissue transition
structure.segment_relations: long limbs relative to a small trunk; long forearms and hands
structure.load_path: trunk mass carried forward and up, an S-curve down to thin straight legs

non_structural_factors.notes: thinness contributes, but the profile curvature and limb ratios drive the read

K04.drivers: Nearly identical to K03: narrow and elongated, long arms, rounded upper-back bulge in profile, spindly legs

structure.axial_section_shape: narrow front, deep rounded dorsal and chest profile
structure.segment_relations: long limbs, small trunk, long hands
structure.load_path: forward-carried upper trunk balanced over thin legs

K05.drivers: Same body type as K01: massive waistless trunk, bowed heavy arms, short bowed bent legs, huge feet
limb_cues: arms held out from the body

structure.joint_integration: bulging knees and elbows, thick ankles
structure.segment_relations: long trunk, short legs, huge hands and feet
structure.load_path: through flexed, bowed legs onto wide feet

K06.drivers: Average human proportions, slight belly and buttocks

structure.axial_section_shape: oval trunk with a mild V

K08.drivers: Typical human, somewhat broad and solid

K09.drivers: Typical human; broad, slightly heavy trunk

K11.drivers: Human with a soft belly and prominent buttocks in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: rounded trunk with a soft abdomen

K12.drivers: Human with the most fat in the set: rounded belly, large buttocks, wide hips; still ordinary proportions

structure.axial_section_shape: round, deep trunk with abdominal fat

groups.label: massive waistless barrel trunk, short bowed bent legs, huge hands and feet (ogre/troll-like)
narrow elongated build with long arms and a deep curved upper-back profile
ordinary human, stocky to soft or heavy

distinguishing_features: K01/K05: massive barrel trunk with no waist, arms held out, short flexed bowed legs and oversized feet. K03/K04: narrow and slender, long limbs relative to the trunk, low-hanging hands, a teardrop/S-curve profile with a rounded upper back, and normal-sized feet. The two groups are opposites in bulk and in limb-to-trunk ratio.
